name: catalan-adobe/slk-api
description: Search and read Slack from the terminal, read-only. It reuses the login the slk TUI saved. Full-history Slack search (in:#channel, from:@user, before:/after: modifiers) across every workspace slk knows, plus channel history and thread reading. No Slack desktop restart, no debug port, no token setup. Use when the user asks to find, look up, search, or read something in Slack ("what did X say about Y", "find the thread about Z", "check #channel", "search my Slack"). Use it even when they never say slk. Prefer this over slack-cdp for read-only questions. Triggers on: slk, search slack, find in slack, slack thread, slack history, what was said in slack, slack permalink.
